description.value: Java Lova Coffee is a locally founded espresso bar and bakery that opened in 2020 with the goal of bringing a higher standard of coffee and baked goods to the Langley-Aldergrove corridor. The Langley outpost sits inside Willowbrook Mall and serves a full espresso menu alongside freshly baked artisan cookies, breakfast sandwiches, and specialty drinks such as a Lavender Honey Latte. A second branch on Fraser Highway in Aldergrove gives cycling tourists two stops along a key Fraser Valley route.

address.value: Willowbrook Mall, 19705 Fraser Hwy, Langley, BC V3A 7E9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at javalova.ca confirms two locations, with the OSM address (19705 Fraser Hwy) matching the Langley Willowbrook Mall branch. OSM tags 'takeaway:only' but the website explicitly promotes a 'Dine-In Experience — Relax and enjoy our cozy atmosphere,' so dine-in is available and the OSM tag is incorrect; delivery is also offered. No bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or device charging are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM tag 'takeaway:only' contradicts website which explicitly advertises a 'Dine-In Experience' — website evidence preferred.
Email discrepancy on website: footer consistently shows 'info@javalova.ca' but the contact page body lists 'info@javalova.com' — likely a typo.
No phone number present in OSM or on website.
OSM address lacks city and postal code; full address sourced from website: Willowbrook Mall, 19705 Fraser Hwy, Langley, BC V3A 7E9.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating coffee shop with two locations confirmed by website; the Langley Willowbrook Mall location matches the OSM record and is publicly accessible.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Avocado Toast (avocado, grape tomato, balsamic on sourdough) and Matcha Latte — both vegetarian; no explicit vegan or GF labeling on website
